summary: Tested featured image display bug fix in Content Library. Bug was that featured images of newly created articles were not displayed. Fix confirmed working: s3_url field is correctly returned by API and images are rendered in the Content Library list. All 7 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verification confirmed images display correctly for both S3-uploaded images and external WordPress imports.

API GET /api/content correctly returns s3_url in featured_image objects
Frontend getFeaturedImageUrl helper in ContentLibraryPage.js correctly prioritizes s3_url over local API endpoint (line 56-63)
useLocation hook and location.key dependency correctly trigger data refresh when navigating back to Content Library (line 96-98)
seed_data_creation: Used existing content items with featured_image (1 item with S3 upload) and external_featured_image (131 WordPress imports)
